title: Mastro
notes: Mastro's file-based router and html templates, served by its fetch handler on node:http as in its Node example. /about is rendered per request: Mastro's pregenerated files are served without a content type unless they have an extension.
details: File-based routes (routes/*.server.js) with the html tagged template, whose escaping is Mastro's own, and jsonResponse. The handler from @mastrojs/mastro/server-filebased is served on node:http through @remix-run/node-fetch-server, as Mastro's own Node example does, on Node, Bun and Deno alike. /about is an ordinary route rendered on each request: Mastro's generator can write the page to generated/ (pregenerate = true), but the static file server then answers the extensionless /about without a content type, and a generated about.html is not at /about, so the framework cannot serve a prerendered /about here without a rewrite it does not provide. The server compresses nothing. Mastro treats requests to the host name localhost as development, so the harness's 127.0.0.1 requests run its production behaviour.
